content:
The formal kick-off conference of the “Digital Construction Revolution – REV@CONSTRUCTION” Mobilizing Project will take place on November 11th, at 3pm, online.

This Kick-off Conference will allow the public presentation of REV@CONSTRUCTION, the project objectives, the main activities to develop and the main results that it proposes to achieve. For this, it will have the intervention of several members of the consortium, from the leading entities of the project, to the coordinators and other co-promoting entities.

The agenda is available here. Participation is free of charge, but subject to registration here.

We remind you that the REV@CONSTRUCTION project is integrated in the Mobilizer Program and focuses on the digital transformation of the AEC sector, to promote its competitiveness, sustainable growth and strategic alignment with the sector at European level. Its R&D activities, developed by a consortium of 20 entities linked to the sector, focus on the development of digital tools and solutions to create the basis for future innovations, attract new companies to the AEC sector, and create new business models to emerge in the future.
